notes: Fiscal year is calendar year: most recent annual report is year ended 31 Dec 2025 (fiscal_year 2025). Costs already in USD (no conversion). Exec Chairman & CEO Richard Hyde. 2025: revenue A$1.54B, NPAT A$567M, op cash flow A$790M, A$584M cash + 27,095 oz bullion, unhedged. AISC per mine not disclosed (group only). Burkina Faso state's free-carried interest in Sanbrado/Kiaka/Toega increased from 10% to 15% in 2025; decree for state to acquire 25% of Kiaka SA for A$175M via SOPAMIB expected to settle 2026. H1 2026: 232,905 oz @ US$1,823/oz; 2026 guidance 430,000-490,000 oz @ AISC <US$1,900/oz. Ore Reserves 6.5 Moz, Mineral Resources 11.8 Moz; 10-year target ~496 koz pa 2026-2034, mine plan to 2035.
